{{Stub}} {{NPC Infobox |image = NPC Strange Rabbit.png |name = Strange Rabbit |type = Quest |affiliation = Fractsidus |affiliation2 = Academy's Dark Side |nation = Lahai-Roi |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} '''Strange Rabbit''' {{Lang|zh=奇怪的兔子}} is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] that first appears in {{Quest|Gold Suspended in Shadows}}, and returns as the main antagonist of {{Quest|Rabbit Reflected in Shades}}.
